expression.description: Filter expression to try, as it would be saved in `config.hogql_filter`: a boolean expression over the fields `inbox-source-filter-catalogs-list` returns, for example `project_name = 'Core' AND assignee_id IS NULL`. An empty expression lets every record through.

source_product.description: Source product of the filter to preview, as listed by `inbox-source-filter-catalogs-list`.

source_type.description: Source type of the filter to preview, as listed by `inbox-source-filter-catalogs-list`.
